title: Ikaav Nysf Lleiv
summary: Defeat newly vulnerable stonemasters to slow and stop Ikaav Nysf Lleiv's rockchanters.
overview: Defeat newly vulnerable stonemasters to slow and stop Ikaav Nysf Lleiv's rockchanters.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Switch to each stonemaster as its shield falls and keep spawned rockchanters controlled.

phases.label: Hateq
phases.description: Remove the first stonemaster while managing charm.

phases.label: Lorasa
phases.description: Remove the second stonemaster as Malicious Intent joins the fight.

phases.label: Veset
phases.description: Remove the last stonemaster to end rockchanter spawning through the flame cycle.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Rockchanters initially arrive every thirty seconds while three stonemasters remain; fewer survivors extend the interval to sixty and ninety seconds.
At 75%, Hateq becomes vulnerable and the boss gains charm.
At 50%, Lorasa becomes vulnerable and Malicious Intent begins.
At 25%, Veset becomes vulnerable and Curse of Flames begins. Killing the final stonemaster stops new rockchanters.
Losing combat heals the boss and schedules a twenty-minute event reset.

notes: Approval E381. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
